name: adblock-security-extension
description: Manifest V3 extension that blocks ads, trackers and malicious sites without breaking pages or collecting user data.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.youtube.config.ts && vite build --config vite.youtube-isolated.config.ts
scripts.package: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --config vite.youtube.config.ts && vite build --config vite.youtube-isolated.config.ts --mode release
